title: Local correction of a dictator
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $w:\{0,1\}^n$ be a Boolean string, let $j$ be a coordinate, and let $y$ be an $[0m\mathbb F_2$-valued vector indexed by the Boolean strings of length $n$. Encode each Boolean string as a sign vector coordinatewise, and use the truth table of the $j$th bit as the input to the local correction of the dictator that reads the coordinate indexed by $w$. The resulting sign is the encoding of the bit $w_j$.
hypotheses_covered: $w$ is a Boolean string of length $n$
$y$ is an $\mathbb F_2$-valued vector indexed by Boolean strings of length $n$
